messages.content:
Two readers answered the same question about machines at work. Reader A used facts taken from a fact
store; each fact comes with the sentence it was taken from. Reader B read the documents directly and points at
sentences. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- If reader B found nothing, decide only whether A's evidence really states A's answer for the exact subject.
- "same" means the two answers say the same thing. "neither" means neither answer is supported.
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": "A" | "B" | "same" | "neither"}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which article of the Regulation corresponds to Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC?

Answer A: "Article 25 of the Regulation (conformity assessment procedures) corresponds to Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC."
Under the Machinery Regulation, the conformity assessment procedures found in Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC are in Article 25. Article 25(2) covers Annex I Part A, Article 25(3) covers Part B, and Article 25(2) to (4) covers substantially modified products.
Evidence of A:
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B: requiresProcedure = specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)." [REG, Art. 6(1)]
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A: requiresProcedure = specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)." [REG, Art. 6(1)]
- machinery or related product substantially modified: requiresProcedure = conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) | sentence: "The person who carries out the substantial modification shall in particular, but without prejudice to other obligations set out in Article 10, ensure and declare on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the applicable requirements of this Regulation and shall apply the relevant conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) of this Regulation." [REG, Art. 18]
- manufacturer or his authorised representative: hasObligation = shall apply one of the following procedures (condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)) | sentence: "Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), or only partly in accordance with such standards, or if the harmonised standards do not cover all the relevant essential health and safety requirements or if no harmonised standards exist for the machinery in question, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply one of the following procedures:" [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
- manufacturer or his authorised representative: hasObligation = shall apply one of the following procedures (condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements) | sentence: "Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply one of the following procedures:" [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
- manufacturer or his authorised representative: hasObligation = shall apply the procedure (condition: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV) | sentence: "Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity with internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII." [DIR, Art. 12(2)]

Answer B: reader B found no passage that states the answer. Its note: Article 51(2) of the Regulation sends readers to the correlation table in Annex XII for corresponding provisions. That table is not in the passages, so the article corresponding to Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC cannot be confirmed.

response.text: {"reasoning": "B found nothing, so only A's evidence matters. A's evidence shows Article 25 is cited in Regulation Art. 6(1) and Art. 18, and Directive Art. 12 text on procedures, but no sentence states that Article 25 corresponds to Article 12 (that would come from the Annex XII correlation table). The match is inferred from topic, so it is not stated for the exact subject.", "choice": "neither"}
